item.description:
Added

  • Calendar refreshes every 3 seconds while the notch is open. It asks macOS to pull from Google and iCloud, then re-reads the day, and stops the moment the notch closes. macOS decides whether a pull is needed, so the timing isn't guaranteed.
  • Timer: an undo button. After any reset, an undo arrow appears beside the stop button and puts back the time and running state you had. It goes away after 8 seconds, or when you start, stop, change the length or switch modes.

Changed

  • Timer: tapping the selected length again starts it over. Pick 25m while 25m is already selected and the countdown returns to the full length; a running timer restarts and keeps going. Before, it kept your progress.
